#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar event for the team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM, 1 hour."""

from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytz
import uuid


def next_weekday(d, weekday):
    """Return the date of the next occurrence of `weekday` (0=Monday) on/after `d`."""
    days_ahead = weekday - d.weekday()
    if days_ahead <= 0:  # target day already passed this week -> move to next week
        days_ahead += 7
    return d + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


# Wednesday is weekday index 2 (Monday=0, Sunday=6)
today = datetime.now().date()
next_wednesday = next_weekday(today, 2)

# Timezone for the meeting (adjust to your local timezone if needed)
tz = pytz.timezone("America/New_York")

start = tz.localize(datetime(next_wednesday.year, next_wednesday.month, next_wednesday.day, 15, 0))
end = start + timedelta(hours=1)  # 1-hour meeting

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Company//Team Meetings//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")

event = Event()
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("description", "Weekly team meeting")
event.add("dtstart", start)
event.add("dtend", end)
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(pytz.UTC))
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@company.com")
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")

# 15-minute reminder
alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

output_file = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(output_file, "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print(f"Created {output_file}")
print(f"Event: Team Meeting on {next_wednesday} at 15:00-16:00 ({tz.zone})")
